page: Amazon Web Services g7e.4xlarge is a graphics-intensive virtual machine instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8559C processor with 16 vCPUs and 8 physical cores running at 2.4 GHz, supported by a 320 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. For accelerated workloads, it integrates a single NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000 GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering 96 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is provided via a 1900 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity features a baseline bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities in specialized tasks. The instance achieves top-tier results in Geekbench single-core and text processing tests. It also demonstrates top-tier performance in large language model inference, processing 1318.31 tokens per second for prompt processing and 31.01 tokens per second for text generation using a 70B model. Standard CPU and memory bandwidth benchmarks, such as stress-ng and PassMark, generally fall within the average range. The hardware configuration offers a high-density resource profile, combining substantial GPU memory with fast DDR5 system RAM and local NVMe storage, which yields high qualitative cost efficiency for memory-heavy graphics and machine learning workloads.

This instance is designed for workloads requiring substantial GPU memory and fast local storage. Suitable use cases include large language model inference, graphics-intensive rendering, text processing pipelines, and data-intensive applications that benefit from the 96 GB VRAM and 1900 GB NVMe SSD.
